description:
Port pi-coding-agent's extensions/events system — the 20+ event plugin architecture.

Critical design: extensions have SEVEN distinct emission patterns (fire-and-forget, cancel-on-result, reduce-chain, mutate-in-place, patch-merge, first-result-wins, parallel-collect). A single `emit/2` cannot paper over this. See RESEARCH.md §8.3 for the full catalog.

Scope (children to be created when we approach this phase):
- `OctoPi.Coder.Extension` behaviour with seven optional callbacks matching the patterns.
- `OctoPi.Coder.Events` GenServer dispatcher with one function per pattern.
- Extension loading + registration.
- Port 2-3 reference extensions (`dirty-repo-guard`, `input-transform`, `pirate` or equivalent).

Definition of done: a custom extension can register a `tool_call` handler that sanitizes bash commands and a `session_before_switch` handler that blocks on a dirty repo.

Ref: RESEARCH.md §3.3 "Extensions system", §8.3, §6 Phase 6.
title: Phase 6: extensions system (seven emission patterns)
